$description: Platform tokens for web: the values the base files gave before the platform layer, plus the new platform names. Emitted on :root and [data-style], and again under [data-platform='web'].

xs.$description: Studio xs is 22px tall and 26px wide. Raised to 24px for SC 2.5.8.

sm.$description: Studio sm is 26px. Raised to 28px so the square icon button (28px in Studio) matches.

md.$description: The web control height the base files gave before the platform layer.

lg.$description: The web large control height the base files gave before the platform layer.

target-min.$description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. Nothing interactive is smaller, including handles (via a hit area).

ios.$description: Touch target on iOS, in points. Source: https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility, default control size 44x44 pt.

android.$description: Touch target on Android, in dp. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Targets and spacing": at least 48 by 48dp.

none.$description: None 0. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

extra-small.$description: Extra small 4. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

small.$description: Small 8. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

medium.$description: Medium 12. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

large.$description: Large 16. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

large-increased.$description: Large increased 20. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

extra-large.$description: Extra large 28. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

full.$description: Full: a capsule (999px, the same as radius.pill). Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Shape" corner scale.

hover.$description: State layer hover, 0.08. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "State layers and ripple" (current tokens; Material Web still ships 0.12 for focus and pressed).

focus.$description: State layer focus, 0.1. Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "State layers and ripple" (current tokens; Material Web still ships 0.12 for focus and pressed).

level0.$description: Elevation level 0: key shadow 0 0 0 0, ambient shadow 0 0 0 0. Colours are the style's scrim tokens: key scrim-30 (0.3 as in the source), ambient scrim-20 (the source has 0.15; the contract has no 0.15 step). Native reads the elevation number 0. Level 0 is 0dp (Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Elevation"). Geometry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/material-components/material-web/main/elevation/internal/_elevation.scss (key shadow at 0.3, ambient at 0.15).

level1.$description: Elevation level 1: key shadow 0 1 2 0, ambient shadow 0 1 3 1. Colours are the style's scrim tokens: key scrim-30 (0.3 as in the source), ambient scrim-20 (the source has 0.15; the contract has no 0.15 step). Native reads the elevation number 1. Level 1 is 1dp (Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Elevation"). Geometry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/material-components/material-web/main/elevation/internal/_elevation.scss (key shadow at 0.3, ambient at 0.15).

stiffness.$description: Fast spatial spring: stiffness 1400, damping ratio 0.9. Small parts (switch, buttons). Source: Material audit (docs/reports/audit/material-guidelines.md), "Motion", standard scheme (stiffness and damping ratio). The web has no vendor springs; it takes the Material standard scheme, which Material also publishes as web curves.

damping.$description: Damping coefficient (not a ratio): ratio times 2 times the square root of stiffness times mass.

top.$description: Safe area at the top. CSS reads env(safe-area-inset-top); native reads 0 and the safe area provider supplies the live value.

bottom.$description: Safe area at the bottom. CSS reads env(safe-area-inset-bottom); native reads 0.

start.$description: Safe area at the inline start. The build maps it to env(safe-area-inset-left), or right under :dir(rtl). Native reads 0.

end.$description: Safe area at the inline end. The build maps it to env(safe-area-inset-right), or left under :dir(rtl). Native reads 0.

keyboard.$description: Height of the on screen keyboard. CSS reads env(keyboard-inset-height), which needs the page to opt in to the virtual keyboard overlay. Native reads 0.
